A.notes: Site A delivers a clean, quiet layout that matches the boutique hotel brief nicely. The SVG illustrations are well-crafted and integrated seamlessly into the design without causing visual clutter. Typography is elegant and structurally sound across all breakpoints.

B.notes: Site B features richer, more varied SVG illustrations that give it a distinct identity, but it struggles with execution. The typography in the hero section awkwardly overlaps the background graphic, and there is a noticeable JavaScript error regarding an SVG attribute.

raw.why: Site A offers a much cleaner execution with flawless visual alignment and zero JavaScript errors, whereas Site B suffers from overlapping elements and technical bugs.
